basics.name: Amer Hamdan
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Engineer · Tech Lead · AI-Product Development
basics.summary: Senior full-stack engineer and team lead with ten years building production web platforms across intelligence, news, recruitment, and commerce. Currently a lead contributor on a multi-product intelligence platform written in Go and TypeScript — a GraphQL/REST/WebSocket API over PostgreSQL, an OpenAI-compatible AI gateway with RAG and per-token billing, and a bilingual Next.js dashboard, all deployed to GKE and Cloud Run. Earlier work was mostly legacy migration: PHP to Laravel, WordPress to Next.js, with measurable gains in performance and engagement each time. Comfortable owning the whole path from schema to interface to infrastructure.

work.name: ID8 Media
work.summary: Lead engineer across the agency portfolio and its intelligence platform — Go and TypeScript services, AI infrastructure, client dashboards, and large-scale hiring products.
highlights: Lead contributor on Sentra, a capability-intelligence platform: a Go binary serving GraphQL, REST, and WebSocket APIs over PostgreSQL, with a bilingual EN/AR Next.js dashboard.
Built Cortex, an OpenAI-compatible AI gateway brokering five model providers behind one token, with per-token usage metering, billing, and RAG on pgvector.
Raised project success rate 25% by leading development teams through 5 complex, concurrent client builds.
Improved software efficiency 15% for news agencies by engineering tailored publishing and content-delivery solutions.
Built large-scale global hiring platforms handling multi-region job data and employer workflows.
Own the delivery pipeline across clients: architecture, code review, Terraform-managed GKE and Cloud Run deploys, and post-launch performance.

Built dynamic page types and a reusable component system the non-profit's staff can extend without a developer.
Reworked SEO structure, page-load speed, responsive behaviour, and production deployment.

projects.name: Sentra

One Go binary hosting the bridge API, the plugin host, and a Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY WebSocket hub
Bilingual EN/AR Next.js dashboard with full RTL support
Per-product databases with cross-product data flowing only over NATS seams
Terraform-managed GKE and Cloud Run across dev, stage, and live

projects.name: Cortex — AI gateway
projects.description: Stream-first AI gateway sitting between model providers and the applications that consume them. Callers speak plain OpenAI API with a Cortex-issued token; Cortex routes to the right upstream and meters that token for billing, so provider keys never leave the gateway.
highlights: Five model providers behind one API
OpenAI-compatible broker across Gemini, OpenAI, Grok, Anthropic, and Ollama
Per-token usage metering and per-consumer billing
Built-in RAG on pgvector and pg_search
Machine translation and agent operations tooling
